note: Contract matrix for the ZBrush-specific postsend, blocked-dialog and install-verify behaviour. Source literals are rechecked with --source-root against the adapter checkout; no live ZBrush MCP tool return was produced.

retryable_busy.condition: code == -32001 and data.retryable is true; a blocked verdict is never retried

source_invariants.meaning: A lost reply after a submitted call is recorded as an unknown execution state.
Unknown outcomes are explicitly non-retryable so a side-effecting call is not replayed.
The unknown-outcome error uses the dedicated -32002 code.
A blocked host verdict is surfaced, not retried blind or auto-answered.
The caller is told to report the block to a human.
The verification/rollback exit code is a distinct lifecycle stage.

unknown_outcome.policy: Once a real method is on the wire, a lost or malformed reply leaves the outcome unknown; the call is never replayed automatically.
